name: Default Class
description: Adds informative CSS classes (region/block, node, user, term) to rendered markup via preprocess hooks.
project_description: Default Class is a zero-configuration theming helper that adds descriptive CSS classes to rendered markup based on information Drupal already knows. It implements hook_preprocess_block() to tag each block with its plugin id, provider, region, and block_content bundle, and hook_preprocess_html() to add node, user, and taxonomy-term identifiers as classes on the <html>/body element of their canonical pages. No settings, routes, permissions, services, or plugins are provided; enabling the module is the entire setup, and the extra classes give themers and site builders stable hooks to target in CSS without writing custom preprocess code.
